answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, expired if not renewed by fresh work, rewards vest against future work. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The karst of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The lagoon is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the oasis. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
